evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'this would take within the next five minutes of your time. Would that be okay?' — time-boxed but no explicit promise of a dependable quote and no real wait for confirmation before moving on.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asks 'What are your biggest concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer on this call today?' — asked before probing starts.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer says 'pricing making sure that it's all inclusive' and rep responds 'Mm-hmm. The pricing. Okay, no worries. We'll go ahead and walk you through how our pricing works' — acknowledges but does not dig deeper with follow-up.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection. Rep moves directly to logistics after acknowledgment.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (house/apartment), floors (2-story, 3-story), rooms (4 bedrooms, 3 bedrooms), parking (driveway/street, garage concern), boxes (30), unit number (1234), square footage (2900, 1600), distance from truck to door (100 feet), access concerns (low hang, narrow pathways) all covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services: Rep asks 'no need help in packing' — phrased as a confirmation rather than an offer, but does surface the question.
evidence_quotes.box_count: Rep asks 'how many boxes are we moving?' and gets '30 boxes' response.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_routing: Rep correctly identifies 2,900 sq ft home and offers virtual walkthrough: 'So normally based on your home size, we do a virtual walkthrough... Do you have time to complete the virtual walkthrough?' Customer agrees, rep sends link and transitions cleanly to walkthrough without abandoning the call.

top_strength: Rep systematically gathered all required logistics details (property type, floors, rooms, parking, boxes, unit info, square footage, distance, access concerns) and correctly routed a 2,900 sq ft move to a virtual walkthrough per the script.
coaching_note: When the customer raised their main concern (pricing/all-inclusive), the rep should have gone at least one layer deeper ('Tell me more about what "all-inclusive" means to you') instead of jumping directly to logistics confirmation.
booking_note: Customer agreed to proceed with a virtual walkthrough: 'I just need, we just need to hang up the phone so you can use your microphone as well. Doing the virtual walk through.' No move date/time was locked in yet.
